description.en: SmartGrid Surveying is a professional geospatial and engineering firm delivering precision land surveying, UAV mapping, GIS, underground utility detection, and civil infrastructure solutions. We seek disciplined, technically competent professionals committed to accuracy, safety, and excellence in project delivery.
description.sw: SmartGrid Surveying ni kampuni ya kitaalamu ya kijiografia na uhandisi inayotoa huduma za upimaji ardhi wa usahihi, ramani za UAV, GIS, utambuzi wa huduma za chini ya ardhi, na suluhisho za miundombinu ya civil. Tunatafuta wataalamu wenye nidhamu na uwezo wa kiufundi waliojitolea kwa usahihi, usalama, na ubora wa utekelezaji wa miradi.

description.en: We provide a wide range of land surveying services, including topographical surveys, boundary surveys, sectional properties, building site surveys, resource mapping, bathymetric surveys, hydrographic surveys, and GIS mapping. Our deliverables include boundary survey reports and plans, cadastral plans for title processing, beacons monumentation, registry maps, 3D spatial data (X, Y, Z), topographical maps, contours, CAD shapefiles, survey reports, PDF map outputs, and other specialized deliverables.
description.sw: Tunatoa huduma mbalimbali za upimaji wa ardhi, ikiwa ni pamoja na upimaji wa topografia, upimaji wa mipaka, mali za sehemu, upimaji wa tovuti za ujenzi, ramani ya rasilimali, upimaji wa bathymetric, upimaji wa hydrographic, na ramani ya GIS. Matokeo yetu yanajumuisha ripoti na mipango ya upimaji wa mipaka, mipango ya cadastral kwa ajili ya usindikaji wa hati miliki, uwekaji wa alama za mipaka, ramani za rejesta, data ya 3D ya anga (X, Y, Z), ramani za topografia, kontua, shapefiles za CAD, ripoti za upimaji, matokeo ya ramani za PDF, na matokeo mengine maalumu.

label.sw: Upimaji wa bathymetric / Upimaji wa hydrographic
Upimaji wa GPR (Rada ya Kupenya Ardhini)

description.en: Every project is delivered with professional, ready-to-use outputs tailored to the project needs:
description.sw: Kila mradi unatolewa kwa matokeo ya kitaalamu, tayari kutumika yaliyoundwa kulingana na mahitaji ya mradi:

title.sw: Ripoti na Mipango ya Upimaji wa Mipaka

description.en: Signed reports and plans defining parcel boundaries for transactions, development, and dispute resolution.
description.sw: Ripoti na mipango zilizotiliwa sahihi zinazofafanua mipaka ya kiwanja kwa miamala, maendeleo, na kutatua migogoro.

title.sw: Mipango ya Cadastral kwa Ajili ya Usindikaji wa Hati Miliki

description.en: Registry-compliant cadastral plans prepared for submission to the land registry for title issuance.
description.sw: Mipango ya cadastral inayokidhi mahitaji ya rejesta, tayari kuwasilishwa kwa ofisi ya ardhi kwa kutolewa kwa hati.

description.en: Durable boundary beacons placed and referenced to survey accuracy, protecting your parcel corners.
description.sw: Alama za mipaka zinazodumu zilizowekwa na kurejelewa kwa usahihi wa upimaji, kulinda pembe za kiwanja chako.

description.en: Certified registry index maps and extracts for parcel verification and due diligence.
description.sw: Ramani za rejesta na vichupo vilivyothibitishwa kwa uthibitisho wa kiwanja na ukaguzi wa kina.

title.sw: Data ya 3D ya Anga (X, Y, Z)

description.en: Positional coordinates ready for design, GIS databases, and machine-control workflows.
description.sw: Kuratibu za nafuni tayari kwa kubuni, hifadhidata za GIS, na mtiririko wa kazi wa machine-control.

description.en: Feature-coded maps of terrain, utilities, structures, and levels for planning and engineering design.
description.sw: Ramani zenye vipengele vya ardhi, huduma, majengo, na viwango kwa mipango na kubuni kwa uhandisi.

description.en: Major and minor interval contours for grading, drainage, and earthworks design.
description.sw: Kontua za vipindi kuu na ndogo kwa upangaji wa daraja, mifereji, na michoro ya ujenzi.

description.en: GIS-ready shapefiles and CAD layers that drop straight into drafting and mapping workflows.
description.sw: Shapefiles tayari kwa GIS na tabaka za CAD zinazoingia moja kwa moja kwenye michoro na ramani zako.

description.en: Methodology, equipment, and accuracy summary signed by a licensed surveyor for approvals and records.
description.sw: Muhtasari wa mbinu, vifaa, na usahihi uliotiliwa sahihi na mtaalamu wa upimaji aliyoidhinishwa kwa idhini na kumbukumbu.

description.en: Print-ready, scaled map exports for sharing with clients, consultants, and approval authorities.
description.sw: Utoaji wa ramani zilizopangwa na zenye vipimo kwa kushirikisha wateja, washauri, na mamlaka za idhini.

description.en: Custom outputs - volumetrics, monitoring reports, setting-out data - tailored to your project.
description.sw: Pato maalumu - volumetrics, ripoti za ufuatiliaji, data ya kuweka alama - zilizoundwa kwa mradi wako.

description.en: We offer a wide range of aerial surveying services, including drone imagery surveys, Lidar mapping, agricultural NDVI mapping, as-built surveys, monitoring and evaluation, solar panel drone surveys, volumetric surveys, and landfill & quarry drone surveys. Our deliverables include boundary survey reports and plans, cadastral plans for title processing, beacons monumentation, registry maps, 3D spatial data (X, Y, Z), topographical maps, contours, CAD shapefiles, survey reports, PDF map outputs, and other specialized deliverables.
description.sw: Tunatoa huduma mbalimbali za upimaji wa angani, ikiwa ni pamoja na upimaji wa picha za ndege zisizo na rubani, ramani ya Lidar, ramani ya NDVI ya kilimo, upimaji wa 'as built', ufuatiliaji na tathmini, upimaji wa paneli za jua kwa ndege zisizo na rubani, upimaji wa kiasi (volumetric), na upimaji wa dampo na machimbo kwa ndege zisizo na rubani. Matokeo yetu yanajumuisha ripoti na mipango ya upimaji wa mipaka, mipango ya cadastral kwa ajili ya usindikaji wa hati miliki, uwekaji wa alama za mipaka, ramani za rejesta, data ya 3D ya anga (X, Y, Z), ramani za topografia, kontua, shapefiles za CAD, ripoti za upimaji, matokeo ya ramani za PDF, na matokeo mengine maalumu.

label.sw: Upimaji wa picha za ndege zisizo na rubani
Upimaji wa Paneli za Jua kwa Ndege zisizo na rubani
Upimaji wa Dampo na Machimbo kwa Ndege zisizo na rubani

description.en: We offer a wide range of civil engineering services, including site engineering, building setting out, underground utilities installation, highway engineering, stake out, leveling, benchmarking, and construction services. Our deliverables include as-built maps, digital elevation models, setting out coordinates, 3D data, contours, master plans, building layouts, CAD shapefiles, and PDF maps.
description.sw: Tunatoa huduma mbalimbali za uhandisi wa miundombinu, ikiwa ni pamoja na uhandisi wa tovuti, uwekaji wa majengo, uwekaji wa huduma za chini ya ardhi, uhandisi wa barabara kuu, uwekaji alama, upimaji wa viwango, uwekaji wa alama za kumbukumbu, na huduma za ujenzi. Matokeo yetu yanajumuisha ramani za 'as-built', miundo ya elevation ya dijiti, kuratibu za uwekaji, data ya 3D, kontua, mipango mikuu, mipango ya majengo, shapefiles za CAD, na ramani za PDF.

description.en:
At SmartGrid Surveying, we don’t just measure land—we deliver <bold>accurate, decision-ready spatial data</bold> that engineers, developers, and project managers rely on to plan, design, and execute with confidence.

 From <bold>topographical surveys and cadastral mapping</bold> to <bold>drone mapping, LiDAR, and underground utility detection</bold>, we provide end-to-end geospatial solutions tailored for modern construction and infrastructure projects
description.sw:
Katika SmartGrid Surveying, hatupimi ardhi tu—tunatoa <bold>data sahihi ya anga iliyo tayari kwa maamuzi</bold> ambayo wahandisi, wasanidi, na wasimamizi wa miradi wanategemea kupanga, kubuni, na kutekeleza kwa ujasiri.

Kuanzia <bold>upimaji wa topografia na ramani za cadastral</bold> hadi <bold>ramani za ndege zisizo na rubani, LiDAR, na ugunduzi wa huduma za chini ya ardhi</bold>, tunatoa suluhisho kamili za kijiografia zilizoundwa kwa ajili ya miradi ya kisasa ya ujenzi na miundombinu.

description.en: Precise Topographical, boundary, cadastral, GIS, and engineering surveys powered by the latest technology.
description.sw: Upimaji sahihi wa topografia, mipaka, cadastral, GIS, na uhandisi unaoendeshwa na teknolojia ya kisasa.

label.sw: NDEGE ZISIZO NA RUBANI ZA ANGANI

description.en: Aerial and Agricultural High-resolution imagery, 3D mapping, and topographical data delivered faster and safer.
description.sw: Picha za ubora wa juu za angani na kilimo, ramani za 3D, na data ya topografia iliyotolewa kwa haraka na salama.

label.sw: Oda upimaji wa ndege isiyo na rubani

description.en: Construction and building Site layout, monitoring, and as-built verification with precision and speed.
description.sw: Mpangilio wa tovuti za ujenzi na majengo, ufuatiliaji, na uthibitishaji wa 'as-built' kwa usahihi na kasi.

actions.href: mailto:smartgridsurveying@gmail.com?subject=Application: Project Manager&body=Hi SmartGrid Surveying,%0D%0A%0D%0AI'd like to apply for the Project Manager position. Please find my CV and application attached.%0D%0A%0D%0AThank you.

positionSummary.en: The Project Manager provides end-to-end planning, coordination, and delivery leadership for multidisciplinary land surveying, UAV mapping, GIS, and civil works assignments, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and to contractual quality standards.
positionSummary.sw: Project Manager hutoa uongozi kamili wa kupanga, kuratibu, na kupeleka miradi ya upimaji ardhi, ramani za UAV, GIS, na kazi za civil, kuhakikisha miradi inatekelezwa kwa usalama, kwa wakati, ndani ya bajeti, na kwa ubora wa makubaliano.

duties.en: Lead end-to-end project planning, scheduling, budgeting, and resource allocation across concurrent surveying and civil works assignments.
duties.sw: Kuongoza kupanga miradi, ratiba, bajeti, na ugawaji wa rasilimali kwenye kazi nyingi za upimaji na civil kwa wakati mmoja.

duties.en: Mobilize and coordinate field teams, equipment logistics, and subcontractors to meet program milestones.
duties.sw: Kuweka timu shambani, vifaa, na wanakandarasi pamoja ili kutimiza hatua za mradi.

duties.en: Act as primary client liaison; chair progress meetings and manage scope, cost, and timeline expectations.
duties.sw: Kuwa kiungo kikuu cha mteja; kusimamia mikutano ya maendeleo na kusimamia matarajio ya wigo, gharama, na muda.

duties.en: Review technical deliverables — survey reports, plans, models, and GIS outputs — for accuracy and compliance before client submission.
duties.sw: Kupitia matokeo ya kiufundi — ripoti za upimaji, ramani, modeli, na pato la GIS — kwa usahihi na ufuasi kabla ya kuwasilisha.

duties.en: Monitor project financials including invoicing, variations, and cost control; flag commercial risks early.
duties.sw: Kufuatilia fedha za mradi ikiwemo ankara, mabadiliko (variations), na udhibiti wa gharama; kutangaza hatari mapema.

duties.en: Enforce HSE standards and company QA/QC procedures across all active sites.
duties.sw: Kutekeleza viwango vya HSE na taratibu za QA/QC za kampuni katika tovuti zote zinazohusika.

duties.en: Prepare weekly and monthly progress reports, risk registers, and project closeout documentation.
duties.sw: Kutayarisha taarifa za wiki na mwezi, rejista za hatari, na nyaraka za kufunga mradi.

duties.en: Support business development through proposals, expressions of interest, and framework agreement responses.
duties.sw: Kuunga mkono maendeleo ya biashara kwa mapendekezo, expressions of interest, na majibu ya framework agreements.

qualifications.en: Bachelor's degree in Geospatial/Land Surveying Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related discipline; a relevant Master's degree is an added advantage.
qualifications.sw: Shahada ya uzamili katika Uhandisi wa Jiografia/Upimaji, Uhandisi wa Civil, au fanya inayohusiana; shahada ya uzamili ni nyongeza.

qualifications.en: Minimum of five (5) years' progressive experience managing surveying, mapping, or infrastructure projects, preferably including donor-funded assignments (World Bank, UN, or development partners).
qualifications.sw: Angalau miaka mitano (5) ya uzoefu unaoongezeka katika kusimamia miradi ya upimaji, ramani, au miundombinu, hasa miradi ya wafadhili (World Bank, UN, wenzake).

qualifications.en: Working knowledge of FIDIC-type contracts, procurement processes, and donor reporting requirements.
qualifications.sw: Ufahamu wa kutosha wa mikataba ya aina ya FIDIC, taratibu za ununuzi, na mahitaji ya taarifa kwa wafadhili.

qualifications.en: Proficiency in project management tools (MS Project or Primavera) and standard office software.
qualifications.sw: Umahiri katika zana za usimamizi wa miradi (MS Project au Primavera) na programu za ofisi.

qualifications.en: Professional registration or membership (ISK, EBK, or PMI) is desirable.
qualifications.sw: Usajili au uanachama wa kitaalamu (ISK, EBK, au PMI) ni nyongeza.

qualifications.en: Strong leadership, communication, and negotiation skills; fluency in English.
qualifications.sw: Uwezo mkubwa wa uongozi, mawasiliano, na majadiliano; ufasaha wa Kiingereza.

qualifications.en: Willingness to travel regularly to project sites countrywide and across the region.
qualifications.sw: Utayari wa kusafiri mara kwa mara kwenda tovuti za miradi nchini na kanda.

engagement.en: Full-time appointment based at head office with regular site travel. Reports directly to the Managing Director and supervises team leads across surveying, UAV, GIS, and civil works units.
engagement.sw: Ajira ya muda wote ikimakini ofisi kuu na usafiri wa mara kwa mara wa tovuti. Anajibu moja kwa moja kwa Mkurugenzi Mtendaji na kusimamia viongozi wa timu katika vitengo vya upimaji, UAV, GIS, na kazi za civil.

description.en: Lead project planning, resource coordination, reporting, and delivery of multidisciplinary surveying and civil works assignments.
description.sw: Kiongozi wa kupanga miradi, kuratibu rasilimali, kutayarisha taarifa, na kupeleka kazi za upimaji na ujenzi wa aina mbalimbali.

positionSummary.en: The Civil Engineer supervises and coordinates the execution of civil works on assigned projects, ensuring construction conforms to approved designs, specifications, quality standards, statutory requirements, and safety protocols.
positionSummary.sw: Mhandisi wa Civil husimamia na kuratibu utekelezaji wa kazi za civil kwenye miradi iliyopewa, kuhakikisha ujenzi unalingana na michoro iliyoidhinishwa, vipimo, viwango vya ubora, masharti ya kisheria, na taratibu za usalama.

duties.en: Supervise day-to-day civil works execution and coordinate subcontractors and site teams.
duties.sw: Kusimamia utekelezaji wa kila siku wa kazi za civil na kuratibu wanakandarasi na timu za tovuti.

duties.en: Interpret drawings and specifications; resolve technical queries with designers and consultants.
duties.sw: kutafsiri michoro na vipimo; kutatua maswali ya kiufundi na wabunifu na washauri.

duties.en: Establish and verify setting-out controls jointly with the survey team before works commence.
duties.sw: Kuanzisha na kuthibitisha udhibiti wa setting-out pamoja na timu ya upimaji kabla ya kuanza kazi.

duties.en: Conduct quality inspections, materials testing coordination, and enforce approved method statements.
duties.sw: Kufanya ukaguzi wa ubora, uratibu wa vipimo vya nyenzo, na kutekeleza method statements zilizoidhinishwa.

duties.en: Track physical progress against the works programme and prepare progress reports.
duties.sw: Kufuatilia maendeleo ya kazi dhidi ya programu na kutayarisha taarifa za maendeleo.

duties.en: Manage site records including site instructions, dayworks sheets, and materials approvals.
duties.sw: Kusimamia kumbukumbu za tovuti ikiwemo site instructions, dayworks sheets, na idhini za nyenzo.

duties.en: Enforce occupational health, safety, and environmental requirements on site.
duties.sw: Kutekeleza mahitaji ya afya na usalama kazini na mazingira tovutini.

duties.en: Support measurement of works and preparation of interim payment documentation.
duties.sw: Kuunga mkono kupima kazi na kutayarisha nyaraka za malipo ya kati.

qualifications.en: Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized institution.
qualifications.sw: Shahada ya uzamili katika Uhandisi wa Civil kutoka taasisi inayotambulika.

qualifications.en: Registered Graduate Engineer with EBK, working towards professional registration (PE).
qualifications.sw: Mhandisi Aliyesajiliwa wa EBK (Graduate Engineer), akiendelea kwa usajili wa kitaalamu (PE).

qualifications.en: Minimum of four (4) years' site supervision experience in roads, buildings, or infrastructure works.
qualifications.sw: Angalau miaka minne (4) ya uzoefu wa usimamizi wa kazi za barabara, majengo, au miundombinu.

qualifications.en: Familiarity with Kenyan standard specifications (KeNHA, KURA, KeRRA) and contract administration.
qualifications.sw: Ufafanuzi wa vipimo vya Kenya (KeNHA, KURA, KeRRA) na utawala wa mikataba.

qualifications.en: Working knowledge of AutoCAD/Civil 3D and MS Office.
qualifications.sw: Ufahamu wa AutoCAD/Civil 3D na MS Office.

qualifications.en: Sound understanding of OSHA 2007 requirements and site safety management.
qualifications.sw: Ufahamu wa OSHA 2007 na usimamizi wa usalama tovutini.

qualifications.en: Excellent communication, reporting, and team coordination skills.
qualifications.sw: Uwezo mzuri wa mawasiliano, taarifa, na uratibu wa timu.

engagement.en: Full-time, site-based assignment with reporting lines to the Project Manager and technical oversight from the Director of Civil Works.
engagement.sw: Ajira ya muda wote, inayomakini tovutini. Anajibu Project Manager na upendo wa kiufundi kutoka kwa Mkurugenzi wa Kazi za Civil.

description.en: Lead topographical, boundary, cadastral, and engineering surveys supporting infrastructure and construction projects with high accuracy standards.
description.sw: Kuongoza uchunguzi wa topografia, mipaka, cadastral, na uhandisi unaounga mkono miradi ya miundombinu na ujenzi kwa viwango vya usahihi wa juu.

positionSummary.en: The Land Surveyor plans and executes topographical, boundary, cadastral, engineering, and hydrographic surveys to statutory and client accuracy standards, producing submission-ready deliverables for title processing, design, and construction.
positionSummary.sw: Mtaalamu wa Upimaji Ardhi hupanga na kutekeleza uchunguzi wa topografia, mipaka, cadastral, uhandisi, na hydrographic kwa viwango vya usahihi vya kisheria na vya mteja, akitoa matokeo tayari kwa kuwasilishwa kwa hati, usanidi, na ujenzi.

duties.en: Plan, lead, and execute topographical, boundary, cadastral, and engineering surveys using GNSS RTK, total stations, and leveling equipment.
duties.sw: Kupanga, kuongoza, na kutekeleza uchunguzi wa topografia, mipaka, cadastral, na uhandisi kwa kutumia GNSS RTK, total stations, na vifaa vya leveling.

duties.en: Perform cadastral surveys, beacon placements, and refixations in accordance with the Survey Act and Land Registration procedures.
duties.sw: Kufanya uchunguzi wa cadastral, uwekaji wa beacon, na refixations kulingana na Survey Act na taratibu za Land Registration.

duties.en: Reduce, adjust, and analyze field observations; compute areas, traverses, and level networks.
duties.sw: Kupunguza, kurekebisha, na kuchambua uchunguzi shambani; kukokotoa maeneo, traverses, na mitandao ya levels.

duties.en: Produce survey plans, beacons reports, registry index maps overlays, and CAD drawings.
duties.sw: Kutengeneza ramani za upimaji, ripoti za beacon, overlays za registry index maps, na michoro ya CAD.

duties.en: Liaise with government survey offices, land registries, and clients on survey approvals and mutations.
duties.sw: Kushirikiana na ofisi za serikali za upimaji, land registries, na wateja kuhusu idhini na mutations.

duties.en: Calibrate, maintain, and manage field instruments and accessories.
duties.sw: Kurekebisha, kutunza, na kusimamia vifaa shambani na viongezi vyake.

duties.en: Mentor survey technicians and enforce field QA/QC and observation best practices.
duties.sw: Kutoa mafunzo kwa wataalamu wasaidizi na kutekeleza QA/QC shambani.

duties.en: Prepare comprehensive survey reports and as-built certifications.
duties.sw: Kutayarisha ripoti kamili za upimaji na uthibitisho wa as-built.

qualifications.en: Bachelor's degree in Geospatial Engineering or Land Surveying from a recognized university.
qualifications.sw: Shahada ya uzamili katika Uhandisi wa Jiografia au Upimaji Ardhi kutoka chuo kinachotambulika.

qualifications.en: Registered with ISK and licensed by EBK as a Professional/Graduate Surveyor.
qualifications.sw: Mwanachama wa ISK na aliyesajiliwa na EBK kama Mtaalamu/Graduate Surveyor.

qualifications.en: Minimum of four (4) years' practical experience in cadastral and engineering surveys.
qualifications.sw: Angalau miaka minne (4) ya uzoefu halisi katika uchunguzi wa cadastral na uhandisi.

qualifications.en: Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Surfer, or equivalent processing software.
qualifications.sw: Umahiri wa juu katika AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Surfer, au programu sawa za uchakataji.

qualifications.en: Hands-on expertise with GNSS receivers, robotic total stations, and digital levels.
qualifications.sw: Uzoefu halisi wa GNSS receivers, robotic total stations, na digital levels.

qualifications.en: Valid driving license and willingness to undertake extensive field travel.
qualifications.sw: Leseni halali ya udereva na utayari wa kusafiri sana shambani.

qualifications.en: High attention to detail with strong computational and report-writing ability.
qualifications.sw: Uangalifu wa kina na uwezo mkubwa wa kokotoo na uandishi wa ripoti.

engagement.en: Full-time position combining field and office duties. Reports to the Lead Surveyor / Project Manager within the survey operations unit.
engagement.sw: Nafasi ya muda wote inayochanganya kazi shambani na ofisini. Anajibu Lead Surveyor / Project Manager ndani ya kitengo cha upimaji.

description.en: Support site setting-out, control establishment, as-built surveys, and alignment verification using GNSS and total station equipment.
description.sw: Kusaidia setting-out ya tovuti, uanzishaji wa udhibiti, uchunguzi wa as-built, na uthibitisho wa njia kwa kutumia GNSS na vifaa vya total station.

positionSummary.en: The Engineering Survey Technician supports engineering survey operations on construction sites, including setting-out, ground control establishment, as-built pickups, and alignment and deformation monitoring under the guidance of professional surveyors and engineers.
positionSummary.sw: Msaidizi wa Upimaji wa Uhandisi huunga mkono operesheni za upimaji kwenye tovuti za ujenzi, ikiwemo setting-out, uanzishaji wa udhibiti wa ardhi, ukusanyaji wa as-built, na ufuatiliaji wa alignment na deformation chini ya uongozi wa wataalamu wa upimaji na wahandisi.

duties.en: Assist in setting out structures, roads, pipelines, and services from approved design drawings.
duties.sw: Kusaidia setting-out ya majengo, barabara, mabomba, na huduma kutoka michoro iliyoidhinishwa.

duties.en: Establish, observe, and maintain horizontal and vertical control networks on site.
duties.sw: Kuanzisha, kupima, na kutunza mitandao ya udhibiti wa mlalo na wima kwenye tovuti.

duties.en: Operate total stations, GNSS rovers, and automatic/digital levels for daily observations.
duties.sw: Kuendesha total stations, GNSS rovers, na automatic/digital levels kwa uchunguzi wa kila siku.

duties.en: Record legible field bookings and transfer/reduce observations accurately.
duties.sw: Kuandika kumbukumbu safi shambani na kuhamisha/kupunguza uchunguzi kwa usahihi.

duties.en: Undertake as-built pickups, alignment checks, and settlement/deformation monitoring visits.
duties.sw: Kufanya ukusanyaji wa as-built, ukaguzi wa alignment, na ziara za ufuatiliaji wa settlement/deformation.

duties.en: Maintain prisms, tripods, targets, and instrument calibration schedules.
duties.sw: Kutunza prisms, tripods, targets, na ratiba za calibration za vifaa.

duties.en: Prepare simple sketches, stakeout sheets, and daily field summaries.
duties.sw: Kutayaricha michoro rahisi, stakeout sheets, na muhtasari wa kila siku.

duties.en: Comply with site safety requirements at all times.
duties.sw: Kufuata mahitaji ya usalama ya tovuti wakati wote.

qualifications.en: Diploma in Geospatial Engineering, Survey Technology, or equivalent qualification.
qualifications.sw: Diploma katika Uhandisi wa Jiografia, Teknolojia ya Upimaji, au sifa sawa.

qualifications.en: Minimum of two (2) years' site-based engineering survey experience.
qualifications.sw: Angalau miaka miwili (2) ya uzoefu wa upimaji wa uhandisi tovutini.

qualifications.en: Practical competence with total stations, GNSS RTK, and digital levels.
qualifications.sw: Ujuzi halisi wa total stations, GNSS RTK, na digital levels.

qualifications.en: Basic AutoCAD literacy and accurate booking/reduction habits.
qualifications.sw: Ujuzi wa msingi wa AutoCAD na tabia sahihi za booking/reduction.

qualifications.en: Physically fit for demanding fieldwork and comfortable working on active construction sites.
qualifications.sw: Muongoza kazi ngumu shambani na starehe kufanya kazi kwenye tovuti hai za ujenzi.

qualifications.en: Strong safety awareness and teamwork orientation.
qualifications.sw: Uangalifu mkubwa wa usalama na uwezo wa kufanya kazi timu.

engagement.en: Full-time, site-based role. Works under the direct supervision of the Resident Engineer and Land Surveyor.
engagement.sw: Wadhifa wa muda wote, tovutini. Hufanya kazi chini ya usimamizi wa moja kwa moja wa Resident Engineer na Mtaalamu wa Upimaji Ardhi.

title.sw: Mtaalamu wa Upimaji wa UAV / Droni

description.en: Execute aerial mapping, photogrammetry, and LiDAR data acquisition for corridor mapping, volumetrics, and infrastructure monitoring.
description.sw: Kutekeleza ramani za anga, photogrammetry, na ukusanyaji wa data ya LiDAR kwa ramani za njia, volumetrics, na ufuatiliaji wa miundombinu.

positionSummary.en: The UAV / Drone Survey Specialist plans and executes drone flight operations and photogrammetric/LiDAR data acquisition, transforming aerial imagery into survey-grade mapping products for engineering, mining, agricultural, and environmental applications.
positionSummary.sw: Mtaalamu wa Upimaji wa UAV/Droni hupanga na kutekeleza operesheni za uruka wa droni na ukusanyaji wa data ya photogrammetric/LiDAR, akitafsiri picha za anga kuwa bidhaa za ramani daraja la upimaji kwa matumizi ya uhandisi, migodi, kilimo, na mazingira.

duties.en: Plan UAV missions including airspace assessment, KCAA approvals, weather windows, and flight-line design.
duties.sw: Kupanga misheni ya UAV ikiwemo tathmini ya airspace, idhini za KCAA, dirisha la hali ya hewa, na usanidi wa flight-lines.

duties.en: Pilot RTK/PPK drones to capture high-overlap imagery and LiDAR point clouds per project specs.
duties.sw: Kuruca droni za RTK/PPK kukamata picha zenye overlap kubwa na mawingu ya pointi ya LiDAR kwa mujibu wa vipimo.

duties.en: Place and observe ground control points (GCPs) and checkpoints to required accuracies.
duties.sw: Kuweka na kupima ground control points (GCPs) na checkpoints kwa usahihi unaohitajika.

duties.en: Process datasets in Agisoft Metashape, Pix4D, or similar to produce orthomosaics, DSM/DTM, contours, and dense point clouds.
duties.sw: Kuchakata dataset katika Agisoft Metashape, Pix4D, au zinazofanana kutengeneza orthomosaics, DSM/DTM, contours, na dense point clouds.

duties.en: Classify LiDAR returns and generate bare-earth models where required.
duties.sw: Kugawanya returns za LiDAR na kutengeneza bare-earth models pale inapohitajika.

duties.en: Compute stockpile and cut/fill volumes with QA against surveyed control.
duties.sw: Kukokotoa vina za makusanyo na cut/fill kwa QA dhidi ya udhibiti uliopimwa.

duties.en: Maintain airframes, sensors, batteries, and firmware; maintain flight logs and maintenance registers.
duties.sw: Kutunza airframes, sensa, betri, na firmware; kudumisha flight logs na rejista za matunzio.

duties.en: Advise on UAV regulations compliance and support tender-level technical proposals.
duties.sw: Kushauri kuhusu ufuaso wa sheria za UAV na kuunga mkono mapendekezo ya kiufundi ya tenders.

qualifications.en: Diploma/Bachelor's degree in Geospatial Engineering, Aviation Operations, or related field.
qualifications.sw: Diploma/Shahada katika Uhandisi wa Jiografia, Operesheni za Ndege, au fanya inayohusiana.

qualifications.en: Valid KCAA Remote Pilot License (RPL) with current ratings.
qualifications.sw: Leseni halali ya KCAA Remote Pilot License (RPL) yenye ratings zinazohitajika.

qualifications.en: Minimum of three (3) years' commercial UAV mapping experience.
qualifications.sw: Angalau miaka mitatu (3) ya uzoefu wa biashara ya ramani za UAV.

qualifications.en: Advanced proficiency in Pix4D, Agisoft Metashape, Global Mapper, or equivalent.
qualifications.sw: Umahiri wa juu katika Pix4D, Agisoft Metashape, Global Mapper, au zinazofanana.

qualifications.en: LiDAR data acquisition and classification experience is strongly preferred.
qualifications.sw: Uzoefu wa upataji na uainishaji wa data ya LiDAR unaopendekezwa sana.

qualifications.en: Working knowledge of QGIS/ArcGIS for QA and product delivery.
qualifications.sw: Ufahamu wa QGIS/ArcGIS kwa QA na utoaji wa bidhaa.

qualifications.en: Strong troubleshooting ability for UAV hardware, payloads, and mission planning software.
qualifications.sw: Uwezo mkubwa wa kutatua matatizo ya vifaa vya UAV, payloads, na programu za mission planning.

engagement.en: Full-time role split between field deployment and office processing. Reports to the UAV Operations Lead / Project Manager.
engagement.sw: Wadhifa wa muda wote unaochanganya kupelekwa shambani na uchakataji ofisini. Anajibu UAV Operations Lead / Project Manager.

title.sw: Mchambuzi wa GIS na Data ya Anga

description.en: Develop spatial databases, conduct geospatial analysis, and produce professional cartographic outputs for donor and infrastructure projects.
description.sw: Kutengeneza database za anga, kufanya uchambuzi wa kijiografia, na kutoa matokeo bora ya ramani kwa miradi ya wafadhili na miundombinu.

positionSummary.en: The GIS & Spatial Data Analyst designs and maintains spatial databases, performs advanced geospatial analysis, and produces cartographic and reporting outputs that meet client and donor standards for infrastructure, environmental, and development projects.
positionSummary.sw: Mchambuzi wa GIS na Data ya Anga hubuni na kutunza database za anga, hufanya uchambuzi wa juu wa kijiografia, na hutengeneza matokeo ya ramani na taarifa yanayotimiza viwango vya wateja na wafadhili kwa miradi ya miundombinu, mazingira, na maendeleo.

duties.en: Design, build, and administer geodatabases (PostGIS/File Geodatabase) for project spatial data.
duties.sw: Kubuni, kujenga, na kusimamia geodatabases (PostGIS/File Geodatabase) kwa data ya anga ya mradi.

duties.en: Digitize, clean, attribute, and topologically validate spatial datasets from multiple sources.
duties.sw: Kudigitiza, kusafisha, kuweka attributes, na kuhakiki topolojia ya datasets za anga kutoka vyanzo mbalimbali.

duties.en: Perform spatial analyses including suitability, proximity, density, terrain, and change detection.
duties.sw: Kufanya uchambuzi wa anga ikiwemo suitability, proximity, density, terrain, na change detection.

duties.en: Produce high-quality maps, map books, atlases, and dashboards for technical and executive audiences.
duties.sw: Kutengeneza ramani bora, map books, atlases, na dashboards kwa hadhira ya kiufundi na ya uongozi.

duties.en: Publish and maintain web maps and feature services where required.
duties.sw: Kuchapisha na kutunza web maps na feature services pale inapohitajika.

duties.en: Ensure metadata completeness and compliance with donor data standards.
duties.sw: Kuhakikisha metadata kamili na ufuaso wa viwango vya data vya wafadhili.

duties.en: Automate repetitive workflows using ModelBuilder, Python (arcpy/GeoPandas), or SQL.
duties.sw: Kuandaa automesheni ya kazi zinazorudiwa kwa ModelBuilder, Python (arcpy/GeoPandas), au SQL.

duties.en: Train and support junior staff in GIS best practices.
duties.sw: Kutoa mafunzo na kuunga mkono watumiaji wapya katika mazoea bora ya GIS.

qualifications.en: Bachelor's degree in Geomatics, GIS, Environmental Science, or related field.
qualifications.sw: Shahada ya uzamili katika Geomatics, GIS, Sayansi ya Mazingira, au fanya inayohusiana.

qualifications.en: Minimum of three (3) years' professional GIS experience, ideally on donor-funded projects.
qualifications.sw: Angalau miaka mitatu (3) ya uzoefu wa GIS, hasa kwenye miradi ya wafadhili.

qualifications.en: Expert proficiency in ArcGIS Pro and/or QGIS.
qualifications.sw: Umahiri wa ArcGIS Pro na/au QGIS.

qualifications.en: Competence in SQL and PostGIS; Python scripting for geoprocessing is an advantage.
qualifications.sw: Ujuzi wa SQL na PostGIS; uandishi wa Python wa geoprocessing ni nyongeza.

qualifications.en: Excellent cartographic design and data visualization skills.
qualifications.sw: Ubunifu bora wa ramani na uwezo wa kuonyesha data kwa uwazi.

qualifications.en: Familiarity with World Bank/UN spatial data and reporting standards is an asset.
qualifications.sw: Ufahamu wa viwango vya data na taarifa za World Bank/UN ni nyongeza.

engagement.en: Full-time office-based position with occasional field support. Reports to the GIS Lead / Project Manager.
engagement.sw: Wadhifa wa muda wote ofisini na usaidizi wa mara kwa mara shambani. Anajibu GIS Lead / Project Manager.

description.en: Oversee daily construction activities, workforce coordination, progress tracking, and compliance with project timelines.
description.sw: Kusimamia shughuli za ujenzi za kila siku, uratibu wa wafanyakazi, ufuatiliaji wa maendeleo, na ufuaso wa ratiba za mradi.

positionSummary.en: The Construction Site Supervisor oversees daily construction activities on assigned sites, coordinating labor, plant, and materials to deliver works safely, on programme, and to specification.
positionSummary.sw: Msimamizi wa Tovuti ya Ujenzi husimamia shughuli za ujenzi za kila siku kwenye tovuti zilizopewa, akiratibu wafanyakazi, vifaa, na nyenzo kutoa kazi kwa usalama, kwa ratiba, na kwa mujibu wa vipimo.

duties.en: Organize and supervise daily site activities, labor gangs, and plant allocation.
duties.sw: Kuandaa na kusimamia shughuli za kila siku, vikundi vya wafanyakazi, na ugawaji wa plant.

duties.en: Interpret drawings and communicate work instructions clearly to crews.
duties.sw: Kutafsiri michoro na kuwasilisha maelekezo ya kazi kwa uwazi kwa vikundi.

duties.en: Enforce approved method statements, ITPs, and HSE requirements including toolbox talks.
duties.sw: Kutekeleza method statements zilizoidhinishwa, ITPs, na mahitaji ya HSE ikiwemo toolbox talks.

duties.en: Track daily progress against the works programme and report variances promptly.
duties.sw: Kufuatilia maendeleo ya kila siku dhidi ya programu na kuripoto tofauti papo hapo.

duties.en: Control site materials, stores, and plant utilization to minimize waste.
duties.sw: Kudhibiti nyenzo, stores, na matumizi ya plant tovutini kupunguza upotevu.

duties.en: Maintain site diaries, dayworks records, and photographic progress evidence.
duties.sw: Kudumisha diaries za tovuti, kumbukumbu za dayworks, na uthibitisho wa picha za maendeleo.

duties.en: Liaise with consultants' representatives on inspections and hold points.
duties.sw: Kushirikiana na wawakilishi wa washauri kwenye ukaguzi na hold points.

duties.en: Support survey teams during setting-out and as-built verification.
duties.sw: Kuunga mkono timu za upimaji wakati wa setting-out na uthibitisho wa as-built.

qualifications.en: Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Civil/Building Engineering or Construction Management.
qualifications.sw: Diploma au Shahada ya uzamili katika Uhandisi wa Civil/Ujenzi au Usimamizi wa Ujenzi.

qualifications.en: Minimum of five (5) years' hands-on construction supervision experience.
qualifications.sw: Angalau miaka mitano (5) ya uzoefu halisi wa usimamizi wa ujenzi.

qualifications.en: Able to read structural, architectural, and services drawings.
qualifications.sw: Uwezo wa kusoma michoro ya kimuundo, usanifu, na huduma.

qualifications.en: Proven labor and subcontractor management capability.
qualifications.sw: Uwezo ulithibitishwa wa kusimamia wafanyakazi na wanakandarasi.

qualifications.en: HSE training/certification (OSHA/NITA) is preferred.
qualifications.sw: Mafunzo/leseni za HSE (OSHA/NITA) yanapendekezwa.

qualifications.en: Firm, fair leadership style with strong problem-solving skills.
qualifications.sw: Uongozi imara na wa haki pamoja na uwezo mkubwa wa kutatua matatizo.

engagement.en: Full-time, site-based role. Reports to the Civil Engineer / Project Manager.
engagement.sw: Wadhifa wa muda wote, tovutini. Anajibu Mhandisi wa Civil / Project Manager.

description.en: Prepare BOQs, cost estimates, valuations, and financial tracking reports for civil and infrastructure projects.
description.sw: Kutayarisha BOQs, makadirio ya gharama, valuations, na taarifa za ufuatiliaji wa fedha kwa miradi ya civil na miundombinu.

positionSummary.en: The Quantity Surveyor manages the commercial function of civil and infrastructure projects, preparing bills of quantities, cost estimates, valuations, and financial reports that protect project profitability and contractual compliance.
positionSummary.sw: Mtaalamu wa Quantity Surveying husimamia kazi za biashara za miradi ya civil na miundombinu, akutayarisha bills of quantities, makadirio ya gharama, valuations, na taarifa za kifedha zinazolinda faida ya mradi na ufuaso wa mikataba.

duties.en: Take off quantities and prepare BOQs and cost estimates from drawings and specifications.
duties.sw: Kupima quantities na kutayarisha BOQs na makadirio ya gharama kutoka michoro na vipimo.

duties.en: Prepare interim valuations, payment certificates, and final accounts.
duties.sw: Kutayarisha interim valuations, payment certificates, na final accounts.

duties.en: Assess variations, claims, and subcontractor accounts.
duties.sw: Kutathmini variations, claims, na akaunti za wanakandarasi.

duties.en: Produce monthly cost reports, cash-flow forecasts, and profitability analyses.
duties.sw: Kutayarisha taarifa za kila mwezi za gharama, cash-flow forecasts, na uchambuzi wa faida.

duties.en: Analyze material and labor rates; maintain unit-rate databases.
duties.sw: Kuchambua bei za nyenzo na ajira; kudumisha databases za unit rates.

duties.en: Evaluate tenders and support procurement negotiations.
duties.sw: Kutathmini tenders na kuunga mkono majadiliano ya ununuzi.

duties.en: Administer contractual correspondence relating to commercial matters.
duties.sw: Kusimamia mawasiliano ya kikatiba yanayohusu mambo ya biashara.

qualifications.en: Bachelor's degree in Quantity Surveying or Construction Economics.
qualifications.sw: Shahada ya uzamili katika Quantity Surveying au Construction Economics.

qualifications.en: Member of IQSK; Registered Quantity Surveyor (or graduate member progressing to registration).
qualifications.sw: Mwanachama wa IQSK; Registered Quantity Surveyor (au graduate member anayeendelea kusajiliwa).

qualifications.en: Minimum of four (4) years' QS experience in civil/infrastructure works.
qualifications.sw: Angalau miaka minne (4) ya uzoefu wa QS katika kazi za civil/miundombinu.

qualifications.en: Advanced Excel plus familiarity with CostX, Cubit, or comparable takeoff software.
qualifications.sw: Excel ya juu pamoja na ufahamu wa CostX, Cubit, au programu sawa za takeoff.

qualifications.en: Working knowledge of FIDIC/JBCC-type contract conditions.
qualifications.sw: Ufahamu wa masharti ya mikataba ya aina ya FIDIC/JBCC.

qualifications.en: Meticulous, analytical, and commercially astute.
qualifications.sw: Uangalifu, uelewa wa uchambuzi, na akili ya biashara.

engagement.en: Full-time position based at head office with periodic site measurement visits. Reports to the Project Manager / Commercial Director.
engagement.sw: Wadhifa wa muda wote ofisi kuu na ziara za kupima tovutini. Anajibu Project Manager / Commercial Director.

title.sw: Mtaalamu wa Huduga za Chini ya Ardhi na GPR

description.en: Conduct underground utility detection, mapping, and documentation using GPR and electromagnetic locating systems.
description.sw: Kufanya utambuzi, ramani, na nyaraka za huduga za chini ya ardhi kwa kutumia GPR na mifumo ya electromagnetic locating.

positionSummary.en: The Underground Utilities & GPR Technician detects, locates, and documents subsurface utilities using ground penetrating radar and electromagnetic locating equipment, delivering utility mapping that safeguards excavation works and informs design.
positionSummary.sw: Mtaalamu wa Huduga za Chini ya Ardhi na GPR hutambua, kutafuta, na kurekodi huduga zilizojificha kwa kutumia ground penetrating radar na vifaa vya electromagnetic locating, akitoa ramani za huduga zinazolinda kazi za kuchimba na kusaidia usanidi.

duties.en: Operate GPR systems (e.g., LMX200) and electromagnetic locators (e.g., RD8100) for utility detection.
duties.sw: Kuendesha mifumo ya GPR (k.m., LMX200) na locators za electromagnetic (k.m., RD8100) kwa utambuzi wa huduga.

duties.en: Perform passive and active sweeps; apply appropriate frequencies and survey grids.
duties.sw: Kufanya sweeps za passive na active; kutumia frequencies na survey grids zinazofaa.

duties.en: Mark detected utilities on-site and log positions with GPS/survey methods.
duties.sw: Kuweka alama za huduga zilizogunduliwa tovutini na kurekodi nafuni kwa GPS/njia za upimaji.

duties.en: Compile utility location data into CAD/GIS layers with depth estimates and confidence codes.
duties.sw: Kukusanya data za mahali pa huduga kuwa tabaka za CAD/GIS zenye makadirio ya kina na confidence codes.

duties.en: QC scan results against records, manhole openings, and site verification.
duties.sw: Kufanya QC ya matokeo ya scans dhidi ya rekodi, kufungua manholes, na uthibitisho wa tovuti.

duties.en: Transport, configure, and maintain detection equipment.
duties.sw: Kubeba, kusanidi, na kutunza vifaa vya utambuzi.

duties.en: Apply permit-to-dig and safe digging practices near live services.
duties.sw: Kutumia permit-to-dig na taratibu salama za kuchimba karibu na huduga hai.

duties.en: Brief clients on findings, limitations, and risk areas.
duties.sw: Kueleza kwa wateja matokeo, vikwazo, na maeneo ya hatari.

qualifications.en: Diploma in Electrical/Civil Engineering, Geospatial Technology, or equivalent.
qualifications.sw: Diploma katika Uhandisi wa Umeme/Civil, Teknolojia ya Jiografia, au sifa sawa.

qualifications.en: Minimum of two (2) years' utility surveying/SUE experience.
qualifications.sw: Angalau miaka miwili (2) ya uzoefu wa ramani za huduga/SUE.

qualifications.en: Certified or demonstrably competent in radiodetection and GPR operation (LMX series preferred).
qualifications.sw: Certificate au umahiri uliothibitishwa wa radiodetection na uendeshaji wa GPR (LMX series inapendekezwa).

qualifications.en: Basic AutoCAD/GIS skills for compiling utility base maps.
qualifications.sw: Ujuzi wa msingi wa AutoCAD/GIS kwa kutengeneza ramani msingi za huduga.

qualifications.en: Willing to work night shifts and confined/traffic-managed environments.
qualifications.sw: Utayari wa kufanya kazi usiku na mazingira yanayodhibitiwa na trafiki.

qualifications.en: High safety consciousness around live electrical and pressurized services.
qualifications.sw: Uangalifu mkubwa wa usalama karibu na umeme hai na huduga zenye shinikizo.

engagement.en: Full-time role predominantly field-based. Reports to the Utility Mapping Lead / Project Manager.
engagement.sw: Wadhifa wa muda wote hasa shambani. Anajibu Utility Mapping Lead / Project Manager.

description.en: Ensure strict adherence to occupational health, safety, environmental safeguards, and compliance standards across project sites.
description.sw: Kuhakikisha ufuaso mkali wa afya na usalama kazini, ulinzi wa mazingira, na viwango vya ufuaso katika tovuti zote za miradi.

positionSummary.en: The HSE Officer develops, implements, and monitors health, safety, and environmental systems across company sites, ensuring full statutory compliance and a proactive safety culture aligned with donor safeguarding requirements.
positionSummary.sw: Afisa wa HSE huunda, hutekeleza, na kufuatilia mifumo ya afya, usalama, na mazingira katika tovuti zote za kampuni, kuhakikisha ufuaso kamili wa kisheria na utamaduni wa usalama unaozingatia mahitaji ya wafadhili.

duties.en: Implement and maintain project HSE plans aligned to OSHA 2007, WIBA, and client requirements.
duties.sw: Kutekeleza na kutunza mipango ya HSE ya mradi inayolingana na OSHA 2007, WIBA, na mahitaji ya wateja.

duties.en: Carry out risk assessments, develop method statements, and approve permits to work.
duties.sw: Kufanya risk assessments, kuandaa method statements, na kuidhinisha permits to work.

duties.en: Conduct routine inspections, audits, and behavioral safety observations.
duties.sw: Kufanya ukaguzi wa mara kwa mara, audits, na observations za behavioral safety.

duties.en: Deliver inductions, toolbox talks, and periodic HSE training.
duties.sw: Kutoa inductions, toolbox talks, na mafunzo ya HSE ya vipindi vilivyopangwa.

duties.en: Investigate incidents/near-misses and drive corrective actions to closure.
duties.sw: Kuchunguza ajali/karibu-ajali na kusukuma hatua za kurekebisha hadi kufunga.

duties.en: Monitor environmental safeguards including waste, effluent, and dust control.
duties.sw: Kufuatilia ulinzi wa mazingira ikiwemo taka, maji taka, na udhibiti wa vumbi.

duties.en: Maintain HSE statistics, registers, and statutory returns.
duties.sw: Kudumisha takwimu za HSE, rejista, na marejesho ya kisheria.

duties.en: Coordinate emergency preparedness drills and first aid readiness.
duties.sw: Kuratibu drills za dharura na utayari wa first aid.

qualifications.en: Diploma/Bachelor's degree in Occupational Health & Safety or related field.
qualifications.sw: Diploma/Shahada ya uzamili katika Afya na Usalama Kazini au fanya inayohusiana.

qualifications.en: NIOSH certification; first aid and fire safety qualifications are required.
qualifications.sw: Certificate ya NIOSH; qualifications za first aid na zima moto zinahitajika.

qualifications.en: Minimum of three (3) years' HSE experience in construction/survey environments.
qualifications.sw: Angalau miaka mitatu (3) ya uzoefu wa HSE katika ujenzi/upimaji.

qualifications.en: In-depth knowledge of OSHA 2007, WIBA 2007, and environmental regulations (NEMA).
qualifications.sw: Ufahamu wa kina wa OSHA 2007, WIBA 2007, na kanuni za mazingira (NEMA).

qualifications.en: Incident investigation training (e.g., ICAM/TapRooT) is an advantage.
qualifications.sw: Mafunyo ya kuchunguza ajali (k.m., ICAM/TapRooT) ni nyongeza.

qualifications.en: Assertive yet approachable with excellent report-writing skills.
qualifications.sw: Mtutu lakini mkarimu mwenye uwezo mkubwa wa kuandika ripoti.

engagement.en: Full-time position rotating across active sites. Functionally reports to the Managing Director with dotted-line accountability to clients' HSE representatives.
engagement.sw: Wadhifa wa muda wote unaozunguka tovuti hai. Anajibu kwa ufanisi Mkurugenzi Mtendaji na kuwajibika kwa wawakilishi wa HSE wa wateja.

title.en: Graduate Interns & Industrial Attachés (Surveying, GIS, Civil)
title.sw: Wanaofuzu na Wanafunzi wa Viwanda (Upimaji, GIS, Civil)

description.en: Opportunities for students and recent graduates to gain practical field and office experience in surveying, geospatial analysis, and civil works projects.
description.sw: Fursa kwa wanafunzi na wahitaji wa hivi karibuni kupata uzoefu halisi shambani na ofisini katika upimaji, uchambuzi wa kijiografia, na miradi ya kazi za civil.

positionSummary.en: The Graduate Internship and Industrial Attachment program offers students and recent graduates structured, mentored exposure to live surveying, GIS, and civil works projects, building practical competence ahead of professional registration or employment.
positionSummary.sw: Programu ya Graduate Internship na Industrial Attachment inatoa kwa wanafunzi na wahitaji wa hivi karibuni uzoefu ulioratibiwa na wenye ushauri wa wataalamu katika miradi halisi ya upimaji, GIS, na kazi za civil, kujenga uwezo halisi kabla ya usajili wa kitaalamu au ajira.

duties.en: Rotate through field survey, UAV, GIS, and civil works units on a planned schedule.
duties.sw: Kuzunguka vitengo vya upimaji shambani, UAV, GIS, na kazi za civil kwa ratiba iliyopangwa.

duties.en: Assist professional staff with data capture, processing, and deliverable preparation.
duties.sw: Kusaidia wataalamu katika ukusanyaji wa data, uchakataji, na maandalizi ya matokeo.

duties.en: Participate in setting-out, control observation, and QA/QC activities under supervision.
duties.sw: Kushiriki setting-out, uchunguzi wa udhibiti, na shughuli za QA/QC chini ya usimamizi.

duties.en: Complete and maintain prescribed learning logbooks and competency checklists.
duties.sw: Kukamilisha na kudumisha logbooks za kujifunza na orodha za uwezo zilizopangwa.

duties.en: Draft sections of technical reports, maps, and presentation materials.
duties.sw: Kuandika sehemu za ripoti za kiufundi, ramani, na nyenzo za uwasilishaji.

duties.en: Adhere to all HSE, ethics, and confidentiality requirements.
duties.sw: Kufuata mahitaji yote ya HSE, maadili, na usiri.

duties.en: Present a capstone summary of learning at the end of the attachment period.
duties.sw: Kuwasilisha muhtasari wa mwisho wa kujifunza mwishoni wa kipindi cha attachment.

qualifications.en: Final-year student or graduate (within two years) in Geospatial Engineering, GIS, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline.
qualifications.sw: Mwanafunzi wa mwaka wa mwisho au mhitaji (ndani ya miaka miwili) katika Uhandisi wa Jiografia, GIS, Uhandisi wa Civil, Usimamizi wa Ujenzi, au fanya inayohusiana.

qualifications.en: Letter of introduction from the academic institution (for attachments).
qualifications.sw: Barua ya utambulisho kutoka taasisi ya elimu (kwa attachments).

qualifications.en: Basic exposure to survey instruments, GIS software, or site works through coursework.
qualifications.sw: Uzoefu wa msingi wa vifaa vya upimaji, programu za GIS, au kazi za tovuti kutoka masomo.

qualifications.en: Eagerness to learn, take direction, and work in diverse field conditions.
qualifications.sw: Nguvu ya kujifunza, kuchukua maelekezo, na kufanya kazi katika mazingira mbalimbali shambani.

qualifications.en: Availability on a full-time basis for the duration of the program.
qualifications.sw: Upatikanaji wa muda wote kwa kipindi cha programu.

qualifications.en: Integrity, punctuality, and a strong professional attitude.
qualifications.sw: Uaminifu, uvivu-si, na mtazamo mkubwa wa kitaalamu.

engagement.en: Three-to-six month structured placement with mentorship from registered professionals. Performance may translate into future employment opportunities.
engagement.sw: Uwekaji wa muundo wa miezi mitatu hadi sita wenye ushauri kutoka kwa wataalamu waliyosajiliwa. Utendaji unaweza kusababisha fursa za ajira baadaye.

 Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. SmartGrid Surveying is an equal opportunity employer committed to professionalism, integrity, and excellence.
description.sw:
Tuma CV yako na barua ya maombi kwa <bold>info@smartgridsurveying.com<bold> ukionyesha nafasi uliyoomba kwenye mstari wa somo.

 Ni wanaofuatiliwa tu watawasilishwa. SmartGrid Surveying ni mwajiri wa fursa sawa aliyejitolea kwa ubora wa kitaalamu, uadilifu, na ubora.

subtitle.sw: Tamko la Fursa Sawa na Ufuaso wa Wafadhili

description.en: SmartGrid Surveying & Civil Works Ltd is an equal opportunity employer. Recruitment and employment decisions are made without discrimination based on gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, or background. We are committed to compliance with applicable national labor laws and donor-funded project requirements, including World Bank, UN, and development partner standards on ethics, safeguarding, and professional conduct.
description.sw: SmartGrid Surveying & Civil Works Ltd ni mwajiri wa fursa sawa. Maamuzi ya ajira hufanywa bila ubaguzi kwa msingi wa jinsia, kabila, dini, ulemavu, au asili. Tumejizatia ufuaso wa sheria za kazi za kitaifa na mahitaji ya miradi ya wafadhili, ikiwemo viwango vya World Bank, UN, na washirika wa maendeleo kuhusu maadili, safeguarding, na tabia za kitaalamu.
